description: Vann og avløpsledninger Indre Østfold kommune is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Indre Østfold kommune. Datasettet inneholder vann og avløpsnettet i Indre Østfold kommune. Dette innkluderer ledninger, kummer, pumpestasjoner, vanntårn, ect. Datasettet klassifiseres som kritisk infrastruktur og er derfor skjermet. Har du behov for data i et av de angitte formatene, send oss en epost på geodata@io.kommune.no. Coverage: Indre Østfold kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Indre Østfold kommune. Its keywords include Askim, vann, Eidsberg, Local, Trøgstad, Spydeberg. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GML, SHP, OCTET, TXT. The listing shows 2026-05-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
